text:
maria: Kicking off a config-only rollout now (cfg-2026-031). No model change — changes are routing weights, batch.window 6ms -> 8ms, request_timeout 12s -> 10s, and eviction policy tweak. Rolling to 10% at 2026-03-15T14:00Z. Pinning model versions for affected routes to avoid drift.

deploy-bot: Rollout started cfg-2026-031 -> 10% traffic. Targets: us-*, eu-*; pinned model tag 'v2026-03-09'. Command: `deployctl roll --id cfg-2026-031 --percent 10 --pin-model v2026-03-09`

ashok: What metrics should we watch in the first 30m?
maria: p99 latency, request error rate (5xx + inference errors), queue depth on GPU workers, and per-route QPS. Also watch prefix cache hitrate and batch sizes.

release-notes-bot: Note created: "cfg-2026-031: routing weight & batching window adjustment (config-only). No model changes. See internal changelog /changelogs/cfg-2026-031"

jen: Observability: slight p95 bump in us-west-2 (~200ms). GPU util steady. No error uptick yet.

kevin: FYI if we need quick rollback: `deployctl rollback --id cfg-2026-031 --percent 0 --unpin` or region-scoped: `deployctl rollback --id cfg-2026-031 --region eu-central-1 --percent 0 --unpin`

deploy-bot: Canary progressed to 50% after 24m (automated gating passed: error rate, CPU, cache-hit thresholds).

ops-bot: ALERT cfg-2026-031: p99 latency > 1.5s in eu-central-1 (alert-id: A-3321).

jen: Seeing an error spike ~0.4% in eu-central-1, p99 increased ~1.2s. Investigating root cause (likely routing hotspot).

maria: Pausing rollout and rolling back eu-central-1 to 0% while keeping us regions at 50%. Region-scoped rollback command: `deployctl rollback --id cfg-2026-031 --region eu-central-1 --percent 0 --unpin --drain 60s`

deploy-bot: Rollback started for cfg-2026-031 in eu-central-1 -> 0%. Drain window 60s.

ashok: Can we revert the eviction policy there only? Might be safer than full rollback. Want metrics to stabilize before reapplying.

maria: Good point — we’ll follow-up, but for now rollback region to 0% to be safe. Opening postmortem-ish thread and assigning eng-runtime to investigate routing eviction logic and batch packing differences in eu region.

kevin: I'll draft a small checklist for next attempt: 1) smaller batch.window delta (6->7ms), 2) run region-only dry-run on staging traffic mirror, 3) extend draining to 120s, 4) keep pin.

jen: eu rollback complete and p99 trending back to baseline. Will keep the hold for 1h then reconvene.

maria: Thanks all. Putting cfg-2026-031 on hold. Will update release notes with region notes and follow-up action items. :white_check_mark:
